name.zh: 欧尔·格尔死灵游戏与一辉战死
name.en: Or-Gaule's Danse Macabre and Ikki's death

periods.type: undead trump-card battle / sacrifice / psychological warfare
periods.summary: After John smashes Or-Gaule's head, the corpse rises by Danse Macabre, stitching flesh, debris and threads into a self-puppeteered body that concentrates the power once spread over countless puppets. Or-Gaule attacks John and Lunaeyes, then binds Stella with threads too strong for her to break. He tells his childhood story as Orles Gaul: born unable to enjoy normal happiness, secretly hurting people with his puppet power, found and pressured by Wallenstein, and finally massacring his village during his own birthday. He frames morality as violence against him and tries to kill Stella. Ikki arrives, stabs his head, and then fights the undead Or-Gaule despite having no magic and only emergency energy from autophagy. Nene protects civilians from Killing Opera, leaving Ikki to duel alone while Stella recovers from strangling and oxygen deprivation. Ikki publicly tells Stella that he will die to buy her one minute and asks her to show the strength gained from their love. He survives the minute using footwork and prediction, but Or-Gaule traps him with threads, pierces his chest, and tears his organs out. Ikki dies declaring his love for Stella. Or-Gaule then crushes Ikki's head to break Stella's mind, triggering Stella's Ultra Awakening.
periods.cause: Or-Gaule's death-triggered Danse Macabre activates and overwhelms Stella while civilians make all-out intervention dangerous.
periods.outcome: Ikki is killed after buying the needed minute and planting hidden delayed cuts; Stella's grief causes Ultra Awakening but she later regains control.
casualties: many soldiers wounded by Or-Gaule's gravity-like killing intent
stella-vermillion nearly strangled and psychologically devastated
periods.significance: Reveals Or-Gaule's origin and true ability, creates the apparent death from the volume's interlude, and supplies the hidden Kuruizakura setup required for final victory.
